description: Electronic integrity evidence registry for artifacts that can reconcile machine output against independent records. This registry is evidence availability and reconciliation status only; it does not allege or prove tampering.

artifactTypes.label: Certified results
artifactTypes.purpose: Official canvass totals used as the reconciliation target.

artifactTypes.label: Reporting-unit results
artifactTypes.purpose: Precinct, ward, batch, or equivalent subtotals used to localize discrepancies.

artifactTypes.label: Cast vote records
artifactTypes.purpose: Ballot-level machine interpretations that can be independently retabulated and compared to certified totals.

artifactTypes.label: Ballot images
artifactTypes.purpose: Independent image evidence that can be compared to CVR interpretation when public or lawfully obtainable.

artifactTypes.label: Tabulator and EMS logs
artifactTypes.purpose: Machine event, upload, adjudication, and tabulation logs that can explain timing or equipment anomalies.

artifactTypes.label: Logic and accuracy records
artifactTypes.purpose: Pre-election test deck/results evidence that equipment was configured to count known ballots as expected.

artifactTypes.label: Audit results
artifactTypes.purpose: Post-election paper or audit evidence that can confirm or challenge electronic tabulation.

artifactTypes.label: Chain of custody
artifactTypes.purpose: Custody, seal, transport, and storage records for ballots, equipment, and removable media.
